lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered vertical columns of high-luminance circular spot clusters located posterior to the gill slits, displaying a semi-regular spatial distribution across the lateral plane.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity pixel bands intersect with the spot clusters, establishing a visible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features defined by a high-contrast vertical luminance gradient (light superior, shadow inferior) are visible along the upper flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
